“噶尔将军，在下李多祚前来相助，请让开一条道路。”只听得不远处一脸冷峻的李多祚对着噶尔弓仁大声喊道。

很多蓝军球迷最后给主队的不是加油呐喊声，而是嘘声，也许在他们看来，球队的糟糕表现实在太过于难以置信了，未等到比赛结束，不少蓝军的球迷已经退场。

施蒂利克看着球场上的情况，只是一味的狮吼，他没有明确的表达自己的意图，这是不正确的，在这样关键的时刻，不仅需要球员们在球场上的自我调节，同时也需要他这名主教练指明一个方向。

房门忽被打开，一长发男子闯了进来，来人身躯凛凛，相貌堂堂，一双眼光射寒星，正是那姬飒城。

然而，他在如今的这个时候，竟然被阻拦在了阵法的面前，这如何能让他心中不愤怒？

卫飞还没有说话，忽然间觉得一阵摇晃，随即身体一沉，“呼”的一下，向下坠去。捎带着下意识里丝毫没有放松开的手，也把杨冰给一起拉下。

“啧啧，看来我是满足不了你们了。不过没关系，我今晚请了一位重量级的嘉宾前来助阵！我看你们一会儿服不服？”成伟梁得意非凡的对歌迷们说。

好几次离妖虎只有丈许距离，从它硕大鼻孔里喷出的热流，几乎就擦着少年的脸颊吹过，激得月乘风额头冷汗直冒，要不是他见势得早，向山坡上爬了爬，说不定就被巨虎一个大爪子，扒拉成了碎片。

所以，此时在他这里，他这也是在第一时间，直接施展出来了防御了。

韩轲将李菲儿扔到床上后，又拿了一条轻薄单子给她盖上，就匆匆忙忙的出门了。

“我赢了。”木梓飞劫后余生的说道，他总算是赢了这场血战了。

如此一来，他就可以光明正大的去上清宗，随机应变的向对方解释，待得授箓完成，还能顺便儿拿到自己的法印和紫芴等一干高阶真人的用物。

"General Gar, Li Duozuo is here to help, please make way." Not far away, Li Duozuo, with a stern look on his face, shouted loudly to Gar Gongren.

Many Blues fans ended up not cheering for the home team, but booing. Perhaps in their eyes, the team's poor performance was too unbelievable. Before the game was over, many Blues fans had already left the game.

Stillik looked at the situation on the court and just roared. He did not clearly express his intentions.

The door was suddenly opened, and a long-haired man broke in. The man had a majestic body, a dignified appearance, and a pair of eyes that shot to the cold stars. It was none other than Ji Sa Cheng.

However, at this time, he was actually blocked in front of the formation. How could this keep him from being angry?

Before Wei Fei could speak, he suddenly felt a shake, and then his body sank, and he fell downwards with a "whoosh".Along with the hand that subconsciously did not relax at all, Yang Bing was also pulled down.

"Tsk, tsk, it seems that I can't satisfy you anymore. But it doesn't matter. I've invited a heavyweight guest to help me out tonight! I'll see if you guys are convinced or not?" Cheng Weiliang said to the fans proudly.

Several times, he was only a few feet away from the demon tiger. The hot stream spurted from its huge nostrils almost brushed against the young man's cheek, causing Yue Chengfeng to break into cold sweat on his forehead. If he hadn't seen the situation early and climbed up the hillside, he might have been pulled to pieces by the giant tiger's big paw.

Therefore, at this time, he directly displayed his defense at the first time.

After Han Ke threw Li Feier on the bed, he covered her with a light sheet and hurried out.

"I won." Mu Zifei said for the rest of his life, he finally won this bloody battle.

In this way, he can go to the Shangqing Sect openly and explain to the other party in an adaptable manner. When the conferment is completed, he can also get his seal, purple fungus and other high-level real people's belongings.
